role: Independent reference reader; descriptive specification only

inspection_scope.evidence_policy: Visible facts derive from direct image inspection. Physical dimensions and text size derive exclusively from the request. Palette and relative geometry are visual estimates, not recovered author settings. Counts derive from the dictionary and have not been independently verified against the source table.

target.requested_region: The BMI distribution column, middle column in the left group of Figure 8a

mapping.y: Eight cohort categories, one horizontal violin per category
mapping.violin_extent: Horizontal extent and width profile depict each cohort's BMI distribution
mapping.color: One muted purple hue shared by all eight BMI violins

axes.x_tick_spacing: Evenly spaced in the reference, consistent with a linear BMI scale
axes.category_label_position: Left of the complete left-hand group in the reference; labels apply to the BMI column as well
axes.grid: Faint vertical gray guide lines behind the distributions
axes.horizontal_grid: No prominent horizontal grid lines visible

layers_back_to_front: Eight solid muted-purple violin bodies with fine dark outlines

statistical_marks.individual_points: None visible within the requested BMI column
statistical_marks.central_summary_markers: None visible in the cohort-wise BMI column; the white dot in the separate right-hand BMI summary is outside scope

geometry.orientation: Horizontal, approximately symmetric above and below each category center
geometry.vertical_occupancy: Violin bodies are separated, with small clear gaps between neighboring rows
geometry.reference_context_frame: The reference has a shared top boundary and left boundary around the multi-column cohort display, with distinct bottom value axes

labels_and_legend.legend: None visible or needed for the single-color BMI panel
labels_and_legend.required_labels: The shared cohort labels and the BMI axis label must be retained in the standalone output

palette.confidence: High for qualitative colors; hex values are unaudited visual estimates

relative_geometry.bmi_column_width_relative_to_one_row_spa: About 4 to 4.5 times one row spacing
relative_geometry.domain_note: Estimated from the plotted extent around the 20/40/60 ticks. This is not evidence that source observations should be clipped to these bounds.
relative_geometry.guide_spacing_approx: Possibly every 10 BMI units, with labels every 20; exact minor-grid construction is not recoverable
relative_geometry.confidence: Moderate; source crop pixels do not prescribe final physical geometry

distribution_appearance.Krieg: Body is concentrated toward higher BMI, approximately the mid-40s through upper-50s
distribution_appearance.Petrus: Several broad or shallow lobes across approximately 20 through low-50s
distribution_appearance.Arner, E: Broad lower-BMI lobe with a longer extension to the right
distribution_appearance.Kerr: Long distribution with a broad lobe toward higher BMI
distribution_appearance.Arner, P#1: Main broad lobe around low-30s with shoulders
distribution_appearance.Arner, P#2: Concentrated around approximately 40, with an extension to the right
distribution_appearance.Armenise: Main lobe around low-30s, tapering to the right
distribution_appearance.Imbert: Main lobe around low-30s, tapering to the right
distribution_appearance.use_constraint: These descriptions are visual cross-checks only; supplied BMI observations determine every density. Do not force data to match these approximate locations.

unknown_statistical_choices: Density estimator or kernel used by the authors
Bandwidth value, bandwidth rule, or cohort-specific bandwidth adjustment
Tail extension, clipping, and whether densities stop at observed extrema
Whether violin widths normalize by equal maximum width, equal area, sample size, or another rule
Whether sharp-looking ends near BMI 20 reflect data, a boundary rule, or clipping
Any original treatment of missing BMI beyond what the supplied dictionary documents

adopted_requested_modifications.assembly: Extract the BMI column into one standalone panel and include all eight full cohort labels
adopted_requested_modifications.typeface: Arial; document an available fallback if Arial is unavailable
adopted_requested_modifications.canvas_preservation: Retain full requested physical canvas; do not crop output to content
adopted_requested_modifications.statistics: Density estimation is permitted; explicitly report chosen method and bandwidth rule; no hypothesis test
adopted_requested_modifications.reporting: Report missing BMI and all visualization choices that cannot be recovered from the reference
adopted_requested_modifications.layout_principle: Use the requested standalone dimensions and text size, preserving category order, density orientation, color family, ticks, and readability rather than copying pixel dimensions

required_data_semantics.grain: One participant record per source row; no pairing implied between rows or cohorts

bmi.use: Nonmissing observations contribute to their cohort density; do not impute or sample

required_data_semantics.cohort: Original cohort label mapped to publication display label
required_data_semantics.provenance: Request attributes the image and released source data to Massier et al., Nature Communications 14, 1438 (2023), DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-36983-2, CC BY 4.0
